problem: Two module sections printed "Im geprüften Umfang keine wesentlichen Auffälligkeiten festgestellt." on a score threshold alone rather than on the absence of findings: render_security (src/output/pdf/detail_modules/platform.rs) on sec.score >= 80 and render_seo (src/output/pdf/detail_modules/seo.rs) on seo.score >= 80. The security section header takeaway made the same claim, because interpret_security_score_localized only ever corrected the band downward (a stack of minor header misses must not read as Critical) and never upward (the Excellent band's text claims no significant issues). Separately, derive_security_recommendations (src/output/builder/modules.rs) tested only for absent headers via is_none(), so a present-but-misconfigured header produced no recommendation at all and the list fell through to recommendation-security-default, whose text asserts the basic headers are cleanly set.
evidence: reports/casoon-audit.* generated 2026-09-19 (auditmysite v1.5.0). Security: score 95 with three open CSP issues — unsafe_inline_script (High), unsafe_inline_style (Medium), missing_frame-ancestors (Medium) — and the section rendered, in order: the takeaway "Sehr gut — keine wesentlichen Sicherheitsauffälligkeiten im geprüften Umfang erkannt.", a metric strip reading "Issues 3" in red, the sentence "Im geprüften Umfang keine wesentlichen Auffälligkeiten festgestellt.", the three findings, and then "Verbesserungsvorschläge: Die grundlegenden Security-Header sind sauber gesetzt." The JSON's own security.recommendations held the two correct actions (remove unsafe-inline; harden with object-src/base-uri/frame-ancestors) and neither reached the PDF. SEO: score 85, and the same clean sentence was printed directly below a table titled "Überdimensionierte Bilder (Top 5)" listing five 1000x1000 images displayed at 309x193. inros-lackner did not show the defect because its headers are genuinely absent, so the is_none() branches fired.
expected: A section may only claim to be clean when it is. The clean note requires an empty findings list in addition to the score (security: sec.issues.is_empty(); SEO: no meta issues and no oversized images). The security wording band is corrected in both directions by security_text_band: a severe (High/Critical) issue caps it at NeedsImprovement, any issue at all caps it at Good, and a genuinely clean run still reads Excellent. Because the corrected band moves the wording without moving the number, the score card is labelled from the same corrected band (SecurityPresentation::band_label) rather than from the raw score — otherwise the card reads "95 — Sehr gut" above a takeaway reading "Verbesserungswürdig", which is the same contradiction in a new place. Recommendations are keyed on SecurityIssueKind so a present-but-misconfigured header yields an action, and recommendation-security-default may only appear when there are no issues at all.
counter_examples: #578 must still hold: a stack of low-severity, context-dependent header misses (COOP/CORP/Referrer/Permissions) must not trigger the Critical band's "immediate action" wording; see interpret_security_score_stacked_low_severity_misses_does_not_read_as_critical.

A genuinely clean run must keep both the Excellent wording and the default recommendation — the correction must not make every section read as flawed; see interpret_security_clean_run_still_reads_excellent and clean_security_analysis_keeps_the_default_recommendation.
Missing headers must not be recommended twice now that issues also feed the list; see missing_header_recommendations_are_not_duplicated.
